paragraphs.text: The Shattering of Madara was an event during the last part of the Mythohistory of Dominaria .

Long after the Elder Dragon War , Nicol Bolas fought a Demonic Leviathan planeswalker on the still-young plane of Dominaria . The fight lasted a month, reduced Madara to a third of its original size, and created the first temporal rift . In the end, the dragon relied upon his touch to defeat his foe. After the battle Bolas feasted on the remains of the leviathan for over a year, absorbing its power in the process. When he finished, naught was left besides what eventually became known as the Talon Gates and an assortment of blubber.
